افتقدنا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَقَدْنَا (iftaqadnā) /if.ta.qad.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# اُفْتُقِدْنَا (uftuqidnā) /uf.tu.qid.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
